outcome: alteration of mitochondrial inner membrane potential
cohort: Cells were derived from three Italian patients diagnosed with megaconial congenital muscular dystrophy (CMD) and carrying new mutations in the CHKB gene.
finding: An alteration of mitochondrial inner membrane potential and mitochondrial network was observed in cells derived from Italian patients carrying three novel mutations in the CHKB gene, associated with megaconial CMD.
